confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable, while hostel and hotel rates vary widely by area and season and are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to draft beer because direct recall of those prices is weaker. USD values assume about 18 ZAR per USD. The fx figure is unverified: it comes from a secondhand search summary that cites this RBA page, which was not opened. It is likely stale, and a usage limit prevented checking the latest observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect general knowledge of Cape Town's typical café, restaurant and accommodation prices, with accommodation assumed for July (winter, low leisure season).

anchor_basis.beer: draft Castle Lager, one standard serving at a Cape Town restaurant, about 55 ZAR
anchor_basis.coffee: regular cappuccino at an independent café, about 50 ZAR
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: chicken-and-chips plate at a casual local eatery, about 120 ZAR
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three courses for two (starters, mains, desserts, no drinks) at a mid-range restaurant, about 1,000 ZAR total
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard spirit cocktail at a city bar, about 150 ZAR
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house glass of South African wine at a restaurant, about 70 ZAR
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: dorm bed in a registered city hostel in July, about 300 ZAR per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room in a registered hostel, about 800 ZAR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic guesthouse double with en suite in the city bowl, about 850 ZAR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: registered three-star hotel double in Sea Point, about 2,000 ZAR per night
